lastTask: Implement Track A2 candidate fitness aggregation

projectState.summary: Track A2 is implemented on codex/byte-a2-fitness-aggregation. The branch adds src/candidate-fitness.ts with a pure weighted scalar aggregator, contribution breakdown, missing-score penalty, ignored-key reporting, and copy-only candidate fitness preview. The helper is exposed through window.persistence for inspection only; it does not write to SQLite and no audio/model/playback/selection/cap path consumes it. Docs record the tunable first weights, and smoke covers bounded scoring plus non-mutating preview. Validation: build green, db:smoke green, smoke 41/41, diff-check green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories. Next likely Track A3: deterministic top-N elite selection and cap/purge loop using existing candidate-store mutations.
